<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Overheard at Breakfast — CTF Writeup</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #0d1117; --surface: #161b22; --border: #30363d;
    --text: #e6edf3; --muted: #8b949e; --accent: #58a6ff;
    --green: #3fb950; --yellow: #d29922; --red: #f85149;
    --code-bg: #1f2428;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7; padding: 40px 20px; }
  .container { max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; }

  h1 { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  h2 { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent); margin: 40px 0 14px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }
  h3 { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 28px 0 10px; }
  p  { margin-bottom: 12px; color: var(--text); }

  .meta { color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; margin-bottom: 28px; }
  .meta span { margin-right: 18px; }
  .flag { display: inline-block; background: #1a2d1a; color: var(--green); font-family: monospace; font-size: .95rem; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #3fb95044; margin-top: 4px; }

  .chain { background: var(--code-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px 24px; font-family: monospace; font-size: .82rem; line-height: 1.9; color: #c9d1d9; overflow-x: auto; margin: 16px 0 24px; }
  .chain .arrow { color: var(--accent); }
  .chain .highlight { color: var(--green); }

  pre { background: var(--code-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px 20px; font-size: .83rem; overflow-x: auto; margin: 12px 0 18px; }
  code { font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace; }
  p code, li code { background: var(--code-bg); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: .85em; color: #e2c08d; }

  table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 14px 0 22px; font-size: .88rem; }
  th { background: var(--surface); color: var(--accent); text-align: left; padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border); font-weight: 600; }
  td { padding: 9px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); vertical-align: top; }
  tr:hover td { background: #1c2128; }

  .step { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; padding: 20px 24px; margin: 24px 0; }
  .step-num { font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .step h3 { margin-top: 0; font-size: 1rem; }

  .screenshot { margin: 18px 0; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .screenshot img { width: 100%; display: block; }
  .screenshot figcaption { background: var(--surface); color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; padding: 8px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }

  .callout { background: #1a2332; border: 1px solid #1f6feb44; border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; padding: 12px 18px; margin: 14px 0; font-size: .88rem; color: #cdd9e5; }
  .callout strong { color: var(--accent); }

  .vuln { background: #1f1a14; border: 1px solid #d2992244; border-radius: 8px; padding: 18px 22px; margin: 16px 0; }
  .vuln h3 { color: var(--yellow); margin-top: 0; }

  .takeaways li { margin: 8px 0 8px 20px; list-style: disc; }
  .takeaways li::marker { color: var(--accent); }

  .tools-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin: 16px 0; }
  .tool-card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 16px; }
  .tool-card .name { font-weight: 600; color: var(--green); font-size: .9rem; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .tool-card .desc { color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem; }

  footer { margin-top: 60px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--muted); font-size: .83rem; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container">

  <h1>🍳 Overheard at Breakfast</h1>
  <div class="meta">
    <span>📍 TryHackMe</span>
    <span>🏷 OSINT</span>
    <span>⚡ Easy</span>
  </div>
  <div class="flag">THM{S3creT_Pr0fil3_H4s_b33n_Ident1fi3d}</div>

  <h2>Challenge Overview</h2>
  <p>Two strangers — <strong>Ponzi</strong> and <strong>Lambo</strong> — share a casual conversation on a resort chat platform. Lambo drops their email address and a vague reference to a social media tool "starting with G" they once used to link their accounts. That's all it takes.</p>
  <p>The goal: pivot from those two breadcrumbs to a hidden online profile and extract the flag buried inside it.</p>

  <h2>Key Concepts</h2>
  <table>
    <tr><th>Concept</th><th>Description</th></tr>
    <tr><td><strong>Gravatar</strong></td><td>A global avatar/profile service that identifies users by the <em>MD5 hash of their email</em>, not a username — making profiles discoverable from an email alone</td></tr>
    <tr><td><strong>MD5 as Identifier</strong></td><td>Gravatar derives profile URLs from <code>MD5(lowercase_email)</code> — no brute force needed if you have the email</td></tr>
    <tr><td><strong>OSINT via Email</strong></td><td>An email address is an identity anchor that links to Gravatar, GitHub, HaveIBeenPwned, and other platforms</td></tr>
    <tr><td><strong>Base64 Obfuscation</strong></td><td>Encoding ≠ encryption. Base64 is trivially reversible and offers zero confidentiality</td></tr>
    <tr><td><strong>Passive Reconnaissance</strong></td><td>No scanning or exploitation — pure intel gathering from public sources</td></tr>
  </table>

  <h2>Attack Chain</h2>
  <div class="chain">
<span class="highlight">conversation.png</span>  (task file)
      │
      ├──▶ email leaked: <span class="highlight">lambobytelotushotel@gmail.com</span>
      └──▶ hint: "social media tool starting with G"
                        │
                        <span class="arrow">▼</span>
                   <span class="highlight">Gravatar</span> (gravatar.com)
                        │
                        <span class="arrow">▼</span>
     MD5(email) = <span class="highlight">d4a5fc5d3128890778667e24617d7cc0</span>
                        │
                        <span class="arrow">▼</span>
     gravatar.com/<span class="highlight">d4a5fc5d...</span>  →  Lambo's profile
                        │
                        <span class="arrow">▼</span>
     Base64 string in profile bio
                        │
                        <span class="arrow">▼</span>
     CyberChef decode  →  <span class="highlight">THM{S3creT_Pr0fil3_H4s_b33n_Ident1fi3d}</span>
  </div>

  <h2>Step-by-Step Solution</h2>

  <div class="step">
    <div class="step-num">Step 1</div>
    <h3>Read the Conversation</h3>
    <p>Extract the task zip and open <code>conversation.png</code>. Two pieces of intel are visible:</p>
    <ul style="margin: 8px 0 14px 22px;">
      <li style="margin-bottom:6px"><strong>Email:</strong> <code>lambobytelotushotel@gmail.com</code></li>
      <li><strong>Hint:</strong> Lambo mentions a profile tool "started with a G" used to link all social accounts</li>
    </ul>
    <figure class="screenshot">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Conversation between Ponzi and Lambo">
      <figcaption>Conversation log — email and platform hint leaked in plain text</figcaption>
    </figure>
    <div class="callout"><strong>Pivot point:</strong> Email = identity anchor. "Starts with G" + "link social accounts" + "profile" = Gravatar. The service uses MD5(email) as a public URL key.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="step">
    <div class="step-num">Step 2</div>
    <h3>Generate the MD5 Hash</h3>
    <p>Gravatar profile URLs are derived from the MD5 hash of the lowercase, trimmed email. Run:</p>
    <pre><code>echo -n "lambobytelotushotel@gmail.com" | md5sum</code></pre>
    <figure class="screenshot">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="md5sum terminal output">
      <figcaption>MD5 hash generated via terminal: d4a5fc5d3128890778667e24617d7cc0</figcaption>
    </figure>
    <div class="callout"><strong>Why <code>-n</code>?</strong> It strips the trailing newline from <code>echo</code>. Without it, the newline is hashed too — the hash changes and the profile won't resolve.</div>
    <p>Navigate to: <code>https://gravatar.com/d4a5fc5d3128890778667e24617d7cc0</code></p>
  </div>

  <div class="step">
    <div class="step-num">Step 3</div>
    <h3>Find the Gravatar Profile</h3>
    <p>The profile resolves to <strong>Lambo</strong> (Lam-boh · Byte Lotus Hotel). The bio contains a Base64-encoded string highlighted as a "prize":</p>
    <figure class="screenshot">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Lambo's Gravatar profile">
      <figcaption>Lambo's Gravatar profile — Base64 flag string visible in the bio</figcaption>
    </figure>
    <div class="callout"><strong>The profile message:</strong> "Funny thing about email hashes, they follow you places you didn't expect." — Even after "wiping" your social accounts, MD5-linked profiles persist and remain discoverable from the email alone.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="step">
    <div class="step-num">Step 4</div>
    <h3>Decode Base64 in CyberChef</h3>
    <p>Paste the string into CyberChef with the <strong>From Base64</strong> operation:</p>
    <pre><code>VEhNe1MzY3JlVF9QcjBmaWwzX0g0c19iMzNuX0lkZW50MWZpM2R9
                    ↓
    THM{S3creT_Pr0fil3_H4s_b33n_Ident1fi3d}</code></pre>
    <figure class="screenshot">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="CyberChef Base64 decode">
      <figcaption>CyberChef decoding Base64 → flag revealed</figcaption>
    </figure>
  </div>

  <h2>Tools Used</h2>
  <div class="tools-grid">
    <div class="tool-card"><div class="name">md5sum</div><div class="desc">Hash the email to derive the Gravatar profile ID</div></div>
    <div class="tool-card"><div class="name">Gravatar</div><div class="desc">Public profile lookup via MD5(email) hash</div></div>
    <div class="tool-card"><div class="name">CyberChef</div><div class="desc">Decode Base64-encoded flag from profile bio</div></div>
    <div class="tool-card"><div class="name">Browser</div><div class="desc">Navigate to the Gravatar profile URL</div></div>
  </div>

  <h2>Vulnerabilities</h2>
  <div class="vuln">
    <h3>Email-to-Profile Linkage via MD5</h3>
    <p>Gravatar and similar services use <code>MD5(email)</code> as a publicly accessible, permanent identifier. This means:</p>
    <ul style="margin: 8px 0 0 22px;">
      <li style="margin-bottom:5px">Anyone with your email can find your Gravatar — even without knowing the URL</li>
      <li style="margin-bottom:5px">Profiles you "deleted" may still be cached or indexed</li>
      <li>Sensitive info in a profile bio is fully discoverable from the email alone</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
  <div class="vuln">
    <h3>Base64 Is Not Encryption</h3>
    <p>Base64 is an encoding scheme, not a security mechanism. It is trivially reversible without any key. Storing secrets in Base64 and treating it as "hidden" is a common misconception — any CTF player or attacker will decode it in seconds.</p>
  </div>

  <h2>Key Takeaways</h2>
  <ul class="takeaways">
    <li><strong>An email address is an identity anchor.</strong> It ties to Gravatar profiles, GitHub accounts, HaveIBeenPwned records, and more — treat it as sensitive.</li>
    <li><strong>"Deleting" a profile doesn't erase discoverability.</strong> MD5-linked profiles persist in caches and indexes long after removal.</li>
    <li><strong>MD5 hashes of emails are not private.</strong> If an adversary has your email, they have your Gravatar hash — no brute force needed.</li>
    <li><strong>Base64 ≠ security.</strong> Encoding and encrypting are completely different operations.</li>
    <li><strong>OSINT chains are short.</strong> Email → hash → profile → flag: four steps, no exploitation, no credentials needed.</li>
  </ul>

  <h2>Further Reading</h2>
  <ul style="margin: 0 0 0 22px;">
    <li style="margin-bottom:6px"><a href="https://docs.gravatar.com/general/hash/" style="color:var(--accent)">Gravatar API Docs — Hash Format</a></li>
    <li style="margin-bottom:6px"><a href="https://osintframework.com/" style="color:var(--accent)">OSINT Framework — Email Investigation</a></li>
    <li style="margin-bottom:6px"><a href="https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef/" style="color:var(--accent)">CyberChef</a></li>
    <li><a href="https://haveibeenpwned.com/" style="color:var(--accent)">HaveIBeenPwned — Email Exposure Checker</a></li>
  </ul>

  <footer>Writeup by <a href="https://github.com/shrikrishnah" style="color:var(--accent)">@shrikrishnah</a></footer>

</div>
</body>
</html>
